source.text:
7. A plane surface is (any) one which lies evenly with
the straight-lines on itself.

source_claims.requirement: Relate plane surface to the approved surface concept.

source_claims.source_quote: lies evenly with the straight-lines on itself
source_claims.requirement: State a meaningful evenness relation for straight lines on this surface, with the correct domain restrictions.

interpretation_decisions.question: What is the formal meaning of evenness between surface and contained straight lines?
How are the line-on-surface restriction and flatness distinguished from a tautology?

review_failure_probes: Do not substitute arbitrary unrelated lines, or a reflexive equality having no surface/line content.
machine_pass_policy: unchanged; this draft never overrides an existing kernel score
